```{r message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Question 10

```{r}
set.seed(210)

B = 20000

mu = 100

sigma = 12
```

#### Part A

n = 10 

```{r}
n_10 = 10
x_10 = matrix(rnorm(B * n_10, 100, 12), nrow = B)
means_10 = rowMeans(x_10)
ses_10 = apply(x_10, 1, sd) / sqrt(n_10)

margin_t_10 = qt(.975, n_10 - 1) * ses_10
covered_t_10 = (means_10 - margin_t_10 <= mu) & (mu <= means_10 + margin_t_10)
print(mean(covered_t_10))

margin_z_10 = qnorm(.975) * sigma / sqrt(n_10)
covered_z_10 = (means_10 - margin_z_10 <= mu) & (mu <= means_10 + margin_z_10)
print(mean(covered_z_10))

margin_zs_10 = qnorm(.975) * ses_10
covered_zs_10 = (means_10 - margin_zs_10 <= mu) & (mu <= means_10 + margin_zs_10)
print(mean(covered_zs_10))

print(mean(2 * margin_t_10))
```

n = 40

```{r}
n_40 = 40
x_40 = matrix(rnorm(B * n_40, 100, 12), nrow = B)
means_40 = rowMeans(x_40)
ses_40 = apply(x_40, 1, sd) / sqrt(n_40)

margin_t_40 = qt(.975, n_40 - 1) * ses_40
covered_t_40 = (means_40 - margin_t_40 <= mu) & (mu <= means_40 + margin_t_40)
print(mean(covered_t_40))

margin_z_40 = qnorm(.975) * sigma / sqrt(n_40)
covered_z_40 = (means_40 - margin_z_40 <= mu) & (mu <= means_40 + margin_z_40)
print(mean(covered_z_40))

margin_zs_40 = qnorm(.975) * ses_40
covered_zs_40 = (means_40 - margin_zs_40 <= mu) & (mu <= means_40 + margin_zs_40)
print(mean(covered_zs_40))

print(mean(2 * margin_t_40))
```

#### Part B

n = 10

```{r}
t_stat_10 = (means_10 - 100) / ses_10

reject_10 = abs(t_stat_10) > qt(.975, 10 - 1)

print(mean(reject_10))

print(sum(reject_10 != !covered_t_10))
```

n = 40

```{r}
t_stat_40 = (means_40 - 100) / ses_40

reject_40 = abs(t_stat_40) > qt(.975, 40 - 1)

print(mean(reject_40))

print(sum(reject_40 != !covered_t_40))
```

#### Part C

n = 10

```{r}
t_stat4_10 = (means_10 + 4 - 100) / ses_10

reject4_10 = abs(t_stat4_10) > qt(.975, 10 - 1)

print(mean(reject4_10))

print(1 - mean(reject4_10))
```

n = 40

```{r}
t_stat4_40 = (means_40 + 4 - 100) / ses_40

reject4_40 = abs(t_stat4_40) > qt(.975, 40 - 1)

print(mean(reject4_40))

print(1 - mean(reject4_40))
```

#### Part D

n = 10

```{r}
sizes = c(10, 40)
cov_t = c(mean(covered_t_10), mean(covered_t_40))
cov_z = c(mean(covered_z_10), mean(covered_z_40))
cov_zs = c(mean(covered_zs_10), mean(covered_zs_40))
print(cov_t)
print(cov_z)
print(cov_zs)
```

```{r}
plot(sizes, cov_t, type = "b", ylim = c(0.91, 0.96), xlab = "Sample size (n)", ylab = "Coverage")
lines(sizes, cov_z, type = "b", pch = 2)
lines(sizes, cov_zs, type = "b", pch = 3)
abline(h = 0.95)
```
